returnPolicyPage.seoDescription: Read CONSTRUPRECO return, refund and eligibility rules for construction materials.
returnPolicyPage.title: Return & Refund Policy

overview.title: 1. Overview
paragraphs: This Return & Refund Policy outlines the conditions under which products purchased through our marketplace can be returned or refunded. Due to the nature of construction materials and bulk orders, specific rules apply.

blocks.heading: Products may be eligible for return if:
items: The item is damaged upon delivery
The wrong product was delivered
The product does not match the description

blocks.heading: To be eligible:
items: The return request must be submitted within 3–7 days of delivery
The product must be unused and in its original condition
Proof (photos/videos) must be provided
Used or partially used materials
Bulk materials once delivered (e.g., sand, cement, aggregates)
Custom-made or made-to-order products
Ready-mix concrete after delivery
Products damaged due to improper handling by the customer
Go to My Account → Orders
Select the relevant order
Click "Request Return"
Provide reason and upload supporting evidence
Suppliers will review the request and either approve or reject it
Additional information may be requested if necessary
The platform may intervene in case of disputes
Approved refunds are processed to the original payment method
Refunds may take 5–14 business days after approval
Partial refunds may apply if only part of an order is returned
Installment or financed orders follow the same lender rules where applicable
Return shipping costs depend on the reason for return and supplier policy
If the return is due to supplier error or damage, return shipping may be covered
Customer-initiated returns may require the buyer to arrange and pay for transport
Bulk or heavy materials may need special collection — details are confirmed after approval

privacyPolicyPage.seoDescription: How CONSTRUPRECO collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store and safeguard your information when you use our marketplace platform.

blocks.heading: a) Personal Information
items: Name
Email address
Phone number
Company details (for business users)
Billing and shipping address

blocks.heading: b) Account Information
items: Login credentials (encrypted)
Profile details
Order history

blocks.heading: c) Transaction Information
items: Payment details (processed securely via payment gateway)
Purchase and order data

blocks.heading: d) Technical Information
items: IP address
Browser type
Device information
Cookies and usage data
Process orders and transactions
Provide customer support
Improve platform performance and user experience
Send order updates and notifications
Prevent fraud and ensure security
We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data
Access to personal data is restricted to authorized personnel
No system is 100% secure — use strong passwords and protect your account
Improve user experience
Remember preferences
Analyze site traffic
We may share data with suppliers and transporters to fulfil orders
Payment processors receive only the data needed to complete transactions
We do not sell your personal information to third parties
We may disclose data when required by law or to protect our rights
Request access to your personal data
Request correction of inaccurate information
Request deletion where applicable under law
Object to or restrict certain processing
Withdraw consent where processing is consent-based

dataRetention.title: 8. Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal data only as long as necessary to provide our services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes and enforce agreements. Account and order records may be kept for statutory periods required for tax and commercial law.

policyUpdates.title: 9. Policy Updates
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The “Last update” date at the top of this page will change when we do. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.title: 10. Contact Us
paragraphs: For privacy-related questions or to exercise your rights, contact us at privacy@construpreco.com or through the Help Center in the site footer.

termsPage.seoDescription: Terms and conditions for using the CONSTRUPRECO marketplace.
termsPage.title: General Terms & Conditions

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: These General Terms & Conditions govern your access to and use of the CONSTRUPRECO marketplace. By registering, browsing or placing an order, you agree to these terms.

items: The platform connects buyers, suppliers, transporters and other business users
You must use the service lawfully and in good faith
We may update features, policies or availability with reasonable notice where required
You must provide accurate registration and profile information
You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials
Business accounts may require additional verification (e.g. company or VAT details)
We may suspend accounts that violate these terms or applicable law
All product descriptions, specifications, and prices are provided by suppliers
The platform does not guarantee the accuracy but facilitates the transaction
Suppliers are responsible for ensuring product compliance and quality
Orders are confirmed only after successful payment or approval (in case of credit)
The platform supports multiple payment methods via secure payment gateways
Prices may vary based on quantity, delivery, or supplier terms
Delivery timelines are estimated and may vary depending on location and product type
Transport may be handled by third-party transporters
The platform is not liable for delays caused by unforeseen circumstances
Return requests must be submitted within the specified return period
Products must be unused and in original condition unless defective
Refunds will be processed after approval and verification by the supplier
Business customers may request quotations and credit terms (30/60/90 days)
Credit approval is subject to supplier evaluation
Late payments may result in penalties or suspension of services
Provide false information
Engage in fraudulent transactions
Misuse the platform or attempt to disrupt services

contact.title: 10. Contact Information
paragraphs: For any questions regarding these Terms & Conditions, please contact us through our support channels or the Help Center linked in the site footer.
